{{Quote|Amm, I would have requested this in person if not for the evacuation&hellip;You know the supply problems we are facing. Our fleet needs that gas. We have every faith in you.|An extract of General Carlist Rieekan's datapad message|<ref name="Freedom No More" />}}
'''Amm Natejeka''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Alliance Fleet]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] ''[[Treasure Trove]]'', stationed at the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] headquarters of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. In the desperation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] evacuation during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] tasked Natejeka with procuring a badly needed cargo of [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] from the nearby [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[Black market/Legends|black market]] for delivery to the Alliance Fleet at its predetermined [[Haven (rendezvous point)|rendezvous point]] beyond the [[Galactic Rim/Legends|Galactic Rim]]. Natejeka never escaped from the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]], however. The ''Treasure Trove'' was badly damaged and lost among the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]] during its [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] run through the line of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] in Hoth's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. Natejeka [[Death/Legends|died]] aboard her [[Transport/Legends|transport]], although a team of Rebel agents successfully acquired the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] gas, completing her mission.

==Biography==
===Alliance service and Battle of Hoth===
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Amm Natejeka was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] serving the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Alliance Fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Freedom No More" /> By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Natejeka was the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] ''[[Treasure Trove]]'', one of<ref name="Freedom No More" /> thirty [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] GR-75 [[Transport/Legends|transports]]<ref name="Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> assigned to [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] headquarters on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="Freedom No More" />

[[File:CarlistRieekan-SWR.png|thumb|left|300px|General Carlist Rieekan (pictured) tasked Amm Natejeka with the mission that she would ultimately not survive.]]
Amidst the haste of the Rebel evacuation during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] of 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Echo Base [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] ordered Natejeka via [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] message to take the ''Treasure Trove'' to the nearby [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin system]] to establish contact with the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] of the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony in order to procure a much needed cargo of spin-sealed [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna gas]], or [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]]. She would be required to return with the cargo to the Alliance Fleet's predetermined [[Haven (rendezvous point)|rendezvous point]] beyond the [[Galactic Rim/Legends|rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] within five [[Standard day/Legends|days]], where, due to dire supply shortages, the Fleet's [[Starship/Legends|ships]] desperately needed the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] gas. Indeed, Natejeka's mission was of great importance, for which Rieekan provided her with a Cloud City landing permit and four identi-sealed [[Credit chip/Legends|credit chip]] cards totaling 12,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to complete.<ref name="Freedom No More" />

First, however, Natejeka would need to safely lead the ''Treasure Trove'' past the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of Hoth.<ref name="Freedom No More" /> The Rebel evacuation plan called for two [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to escort each escape transport past the waiting line of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] under the protective fire of Echo Base's planet-based [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|ion cannon]].<ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> However, the ''Treasure Trove'' never made it out of the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]].<ref name="Freedom No More" />

===Escaping Hoth and Natejeka's death===
[[File:Hoth_TEA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Hoth, where Natejeda fled before her death]]
Natejeka missed the ''Treasure Trove''{{'s}} rendezvous mark at the Alliance Fleet by thirty-six [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]], prompting grave concern from Rieekan, who did not know what had become of the missing transport. The ''Treasure Trove''{{'s}} starfighter escort did make it to the rendezvous point, however, reporting that Natejeka's transport may have been lost among the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]]. Facing the Fleet's grave supply shortages, Rieekan dispatched a team of Rebel agents to search for signs of the missing ''Treasure Trove''.<ref name="Freedom No More" />

The agents discovered the badly damaged ''Treasure Trove'' lining the shallow crater of a giant [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the Hoth [[Asteroid field/Legends|belt]], with [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] indicating a lone lifeform remaining aboard. After boarding the transport's command pod, which glowed only with the dim light of emergency power and suffered from very feint [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] due to a [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] leak, they found a broken Human form lying in a damaged and still-docked [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]&mdash;Amm Natejeka, the ''Treasure Trove''{{'s}} sole survivor.<ref name="Freedom No More" />

Terror-stricken, Natejeka was dressed in an emergency [[Environment suit/Legends|vacuum suit]], though the legging had been torn, and her [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] wound there had frozen. Weakly clutching a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and a datapad, which contained Rieekan's message on its screen, Natejeka [[Death/Legends|died]] from her wounds and exposure to vacuum just as the Rebel agents approached her. They discerned her identity and blaster gas procurement mission from Rieekan from the datapad's readout.<ref name="Freedom No More" />

[[File:Bespin_skyscrapers.png|thumb|left|250px|Natejeka was tasked with going to Cloud City, to which she never made it before her own death.]]
Although Natejeka failed in her mission to supply the Alliance Fleet with the valuable shipment of blaster gas, and while the ''Treasure Trove'' became one of<ref name="Freedom No More" /> seventeen Rebel GR-75 medium transports destroyed during the Battle of Hoth,<ref name="Essential Atlas" /> the Rebel agents picked up where she had left off. They successfully acquired the blaster gas from Cloud City and delivered it to the Rebels' rendezvous point in her stead.<ref name="Freedom No More" />

==Equipment==
Aboard the damaged ''Treasure Trove'', the wounded Natejeka donned a vacc suit in the face of a diminishing [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] supply and crawled inside an escape pod with her datapad. She died with a look of terror on her face while clutching a blaster pistol in her [[Limb/Legends|hand]].<ref name="Freedom No More" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Amm Natejeka appears only in the [[1996]] second edition of the [[West End Games]] sourcebook [[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'']] as part of a special [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] supplement entitled ''Freedom No More'', written by author [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. The players of the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure take up Natejeka's mission to deliver blaster gas to the Alliance Fleet, visiting familiar locations such as the Hoth asteroid field and Cloud City in the [[Time/Legends|time]] frame paralleling the events in the film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="Freedom No More" />
